title: County distressed-property source specs (batch 1 + batch 2)
how_collected: Government and official sites only, about 1 request per second, one page or one small query per source; stopped on 401/403/429; no login, CAPTCHA, paywall or bot check bypassed; no people-search or listing sites. Owner values were never copied.

field_notes.access: open | captcha | login | forbidden. "forbidden" covers both terms that ban automation and hosts that answered HTTP 403/429 or a Cloudflare check.
field_notes.automatable: true only when the source is open, free, has no CAPTCHA or login, was sampled on sample_checked_at, and is machine-readable or a stable simple list.
field_notes.statewide_rows: county "Statewide" rows cover every county in that state.

Mostly multi-family. Related datasets found via search, not fetched: Repeat Offender Property Deficiencies ge82-ij4h, Property Activity 5yf8-fm7j, Violation Cases with NOV link cdze-ufp8.

sources.source_name: Travis County Odyssey court portal (probate cases)
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. County Clerk says probate case data from June 1986 and redacted images from Dec 2005 are online; data updated every 24 hours; registration not required. Odyssey Smart Search usually has a reCAPTCHA (not verified). Browser-only.

sources.source_name: Linebarger Goggan Blair & Sampson tax sale properties (law firm, non-government)
sources.notes: Fetched; only the page title rendered (JavaScript app). Multi-county Texas tax sale map run by a delinquent-tax law firm. No API confirmed in this pass; terms not checked. Worth a browser check for Bexar, Denton, Travis, Harris and Kaufman listings.

sources.source_name: McCreary Veselka Bragg & Allen tax sales (law firm, non-government)
sources.notes: Fetched home page: no upcoming sales visible for our counties; site has Login/Register, a User Agreement and a Past Sales archive (/home/archive). Mostly central Texas counties (e.g. Williamson). Terms not read; treat as browser-only.

sources.source_name: Guilford County GIS - ForeclosuresPublic layer (tax foreclosure pipeline)
sources.notes: Best NC find. Backs the county 'Research Properties in Foreclosure' dashboard. Every row is FLAG_TYPE 'FLAGMORTGAGE' (mortgage-style tax foreclosure under NC GS 105-374, not bank foreclosures). Status split on 2026-11-09: Assigned To Attorney 854, Notice of Sale 12, Upset Bid 6, Pending Confirmation 14. 'Assigned To Attorney' is the early, pre-sale stage, so this gives months of lead time. Has Owner, Owner_History and mailing address fields (values not copied). Query capability only, maxRecordCount 2000. Sales are handled by Zacchaeus Legal Services. Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: Guilford County Preview of Foreclosures page (links to dashboard and new Experience Builder app)
sources.notes: Landing page only. Says the current dashboard (gcgis portal dashboards id 2530a4f70ee3431bb0d561994b4b8eb0) will soon be replaced by an 'Advanced Foreclosure Properties Map & Search' app (experiencebuilder id c8d88c0dc2884860ac98ae9a777839e6). Watch for the layer URL changing when the new app launches. Use the ArcGIS layer above instead.

sources.source_name: Zacchaeus Legal Services (ZLS-NC) tax foreclosure properties for sale
sources.notes: Private law firm contracted by several NC counties (Guilford and Forsyth point to it). Notices sit behind an 'I AGREE / I DO NOT AGREE' disclaimer click-through, so not automatable under our rules. No listings or counties were visible in the fetch; opening bid is posted the day before the sale. No anti-bot terms seen, but the click-through itself rules it out. Browser-only.

sources.source_name: Forsyth County Tax - Property Tax Foreclosure Sales list
sources.notes: Stable HTML blocks, one per property: address, case number (e.g. 'NN CVD NNNNNN-330'), status, PIN, tax value, owner, sale date. Min Bid was blank on all 9. Sale dates 2026-05-08, 2026-08-07 and 2026-11-06 (the October 9 sale was moved to November 6). 3 rows were in the upset-bid period and 6 were pending confirmation. Same page is mirrored on forsyth.cc and co.forsyth.nc.us; use one host. Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: Forsyth County advertisement of 2025 tax liens (A-F, G-O, P-Z PDFs)
sources.notes: Annual NC GS 105-369 lien advertisement for 2025 unpaid taxes, published the week of 2026-05-19. Three PDFs split by owner last name. The page says each entry has a brief property description, the listed owner and the principal tax amount. PDFs were not opened, so parcel and address columns are not confirmed. Covers the county, Winston-Salem, Kernersville, Clemmons and other towns. Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: Forsyth County GIS - Bank Foreclosure layer (historical)
sources.notes: Mortgage foreclosure filings with ADDRESS, TAXPIN, DATE_, MORTGAGE_AMT (original loan, not payoff), lender. No owner field. Stale: covers 2007 to June 2021 only (newest date 2021-06-28). Useful only as history, such as repeat distress. Not a current lead feed. Stale: stops in June 2021. History only, not a lead feed.

sources.source_name: Winston-Salem CommDev - Delinquent Real Estate Feb 2019 and City-owned parcels
sources.notes: Layer 0 is 'Delinquent Real Estate - Feb 2019' and layer 1 is 'Parcels Owned by City of WS - Feb 2019'. A one-time 2019 snapshot, so too stale to use. Field lists not fetched.

sources.source_name: City of Winston-Salem Accela Citizen Access (code enforcement case lookup)
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. City case lookup for code enforcement; per search results, anonymous users see limited information. No open code-case dataset was found for Winston-Salem. The county handles minimum housing outside Winston-Salem and Kernersville city limits.

sources.source_name: Wake County Tax Administration - properties in tax foreclosure
sources.notes: Plain-text blocks grouped by town (most say 'None at this time'). Each block has a Tax ID linked to the real-estate account, the judgment amount, address, date of first action, date the judgment was docketed and the sale date (all 'To Be Announced'). No owner or case number. Last updated 2026-10-22. Sold through the Sheriff under NC GS 105-375 (in rem). Small volume. The page also points to a separate Clerk of Superior Court listing of deed-of-trust foreclosures (not fetched; a cached copy from 2024 was empty). Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: Wake County code cases opened in the past 90 days
sources.notes: Published by Wake County (data-wake.opendata.arcgis.com, CC BY 4.0). Last edit 2026-11-09, so it refreshes daily. Rolling 90-day window. Covers the county's own jurisdiction plus Wendell, not Raleigh: Planning/Zoning 263, Wastewater 76, Building Inspections 55, Town of Wendell 38, Watershed 2. No owner field. The service name contains '_test', but it is the layer linked from the catalog. CSV/GeoJSON downloads are also offered on the hub.

sources.source_name: City of Raleigh - Ask Raleigh Requests (service requests incl. Unsafe Housing Conditions, Public Nuisance)
sources.notes: These are resident complaints, not confirmed code cases. Housing & Neighborhoods counts: Public Nuisance 1172, Unsafe Housing Conditions 44. Filter SERVICE='Unsafe Housing Conditions' for a distress signal. No owner field. Last edit 2026-11-09. Raleigh's open data portal (data.raleighnc.gov) has no code-violation case dataset.

sources.source_name: Durham County Tax Administration - Foreclosures for Auction
sources.notes: Table of Parcel, Status and Last Updated. Each parcel links to a notice PDF (/Tax-Administration1/Documents/Foreclosure-Documents/<parcel>.pdf). Per search results, the PDFs carry the address and an estimated minimum bid. One row on 2026-11-09, status 'Sale Cancelled'. The FAQ says sales are the 2nd Tuesday of each month at noon. The old URL /county-departments/.../tax-administration/foreclosure returns 404. Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: Durham County Delinquent Taxpayer List (Spatialest app)
sources.notes: Linked from the county tax foreclosure page. A JavaScript single-page app; the fetch returned only the menu shell, so columns and count are unknown. A backing JSON endpoint may exist, but it was not probed. Hosted by a vendor (Spatialest). Browser-only for now. Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: City of Durham GIS - Available and Surplus Property
sources.notes: Found via search; the fetch failed with no output (not an HTTP code), and webgis2.durhamnc.gov also failed. Per search snippets, it covers 88 city- and county-owned parcels picked in August 2025 as affordable-housing candidates. These are public-owned parcels, not owner leads. The county surplus page (dconc.gov real estate) showed none available per search results.

sources.source_name: Union County Property Tax Foreclosures page (presentation + delinquent list)
sources.notes: HTTP 403 to our fetch, so the host was not used again. Per search results, the page has a 'Properties Currently in Tax Foreclosures' document and a delinquent tax list copy (showpublisheddocument PDFs), with sales at the Union County Judicial Center, Monroe. Browser-only.

sources.source_name: Union County Delinquent Tax Lien Advertisement
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched, because the same county site returned 403. Annual NC GS 105-369 lien advertisement. Browser-only.

sources.source_name: Cleveland County - Find Tax Foreclosures & County Owned Properties for Sale
sources.notes: Numbered text lists. Two upcoming auctions covering 5 parcels in the upset-bid stage, plus 8 parcels still in the court process (one marked 'on hold'), which gives early pre-sale leads. Each has a parcel number, court file number and address. County-owned parcels for sale: none. No owner field. Foreclosures handled by Kania Law Firm are listed on that firm's site instead (403). Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: Kania Law Firm tax foreclosure listings (Cleveland, Lincoln and other NC counties)
sources.notes: HTTP 403 to our fetch, so the host was not used again. Cleveland links here, and Lincoln names Kania as its tax foreclosure firm. Browser-only.

sources.source_name: Lincoln County Foreclosures page
sources.notes: Currently says 'There are no tax foreclosures at this time.' Sales are on the courthouse steps in Lincolnton, and the Kania Law Firm handles them (its site returns 403). Worth a cheap periodic check for change. Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: Lincoln County 2024 Tax Year Delinquent Tax Lien notice (PDF)
sources.notes: Text-based PDF (not scanned), 38 pages, notice under NC GS 105-369 for 2024 taxes (county, Lincolnton and special districts). About 1,615 dollar amounts found, which is roughly the entry count. Per the county notice, it lists the owner, Parcel ID and tax amount; no street address was confirmed. A 2025-tax-year version should appear in the DocumentCenter each spring under a new View id. Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: Iredell County website (tax foreclosure / tax collector pages)
sources.notes: One site-search GET timed out after 60 seconds; not retried. Web search found no official Iredell tax foreclosure list page. Only paid aggregators (taxsaleresources) list Iredell sales (2026-04-13, 10 parcels; 2026-08-17, 2 parcels; held at the courthouse door, Statesville). Needs a browser check.

sources.source_name: Iredell County Tax Bill Search
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. Per-parcel bill lookup, useful for checking one property's balance, not for a delinquent list.

sources.source_name: NC eCourts portal (special proceedings foreclosures, estate files)
sources.notes: Already known from batch 1; not re-tested. Human-verification CAPTCHA for automation. Holds SP foreclosure and E estate (probate) files for all 8 counties. Cleveland County links here to check upset-bid status. Operator browser only.

sources.source_name: ncnotices.com (NC Press Association legal notices)
sources.notes: Already known; not re-tested. A CAPTCHA per notice, and the terms ban scraping. Covers notices of sale and tax lien ads that ran in newspapers.

sources.source_name: SC Judicial Branch Public Index (county case records search, incl. foreclosure / Master-in-Equity cases)
sources.notes: Already known from batch 1: refused automated requests (HTTP 406/400). Browser only. Several SC counties (Beaufort, Horry) point their Master-in-Equity foreclosure rosters here, so it likely covers Richland/Greenville/Spartanburg/Lancaster/Chester too. Not re-tested.

sources.source_name: SC Press Association public notices (scpublicnotices.com)
sources.notes: Already known from batch 1: needs a search form submission. Carries Master-in-Equity sale notices and Delinquent Tax Sale ads statewide. Not re-tested.

Site map also lists /194/Delinquent-Tax-Collection and /198/Tax-Sale-Procedures. Content and list format unknown. County site moved from mylancastersc.org to lancastercountysc.gov (301).

sources.source_name: Lancaster County Forfeited Land Commission - View Forfeited Properties
sources.notes: HTTP 429 (same burst as above). Unsold tax-sale parcels held by the Forfeited Land Commission. Related page /480/Forfeited-Properties-Available. Format not seen. Worth a slow browser check later.

sources.source_name: Lancaster County Report a Code Enforcement Violation
sources.notes: Found via the county site map, not fetched (host returned 429). Appears to be a complaint form, not a case list. No public code-case dataset found.

sources.source_name: Chester County Tax Collector (delinquent tax sale)
sources.notes: HTTP 403 Forbidden on first request. Stopped. No other Chester County source (Master-in-Equity list, code cases, open data) surfaced in search. Statewide sources (Public Index, scpublicnotices) are the fallback.

sources.source_name: Richland County Treasurer annual Tax Sale page
sources.notes: Information page only, no property list linked. 2026 sale was Nov 2-3, 2026 (Township Auditorium); bidder registration closed Oct 26. Page says the list is sorted by owner last name (i.e. the newspaper ad). No automation terms on the page. Next useful window is ~Sep-Oct 2027 when the ad runs.

Unsold tax-sale parcels; sealed-bid sale in December. Could be automatable if a normal browser fetch works; needs a browser check.

sources.source_name: Richland County Master-in-Equity Foreclosure Sales page

sources.source_name: The Columbia Star - Master's Sales legal notices
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. Newspaper page of Richland Master-in-Equity sale notices (the example found was for a May 2025 sale). Fields from search description only. A private newspaper, so terms not checked.

sources.source_name: City of Columbia open data - Code Cases

NO address and NO parcel field (columns: codecaseid, codecasenumber, codecasetypename, districtname, codecasestatusname, status flags, openeddate, closeddate, balancedue). Not useful for leads as-is. No owner field. Stale: stopped updating July 2022 and has no address or parcel.

sources.notes: The REST directory URL (/cola/rest/services?f=json) redirects (307) to an ArcGIS Experience Builder app, so no layer list was readable. Search mentions a code enforcement viewer; a browser session could reveal the underlying FeatureServer. City also runs a vacant building registration program (columbiapd.net), no public list found.

sources.source_name: Greenville County Master in Equity Sales roster
sources.notes: HTTP 403 Forbidden on first request. Stopped using the host (also greenvillecounty.org, which appears to be the same site). Search says sales are first Monday monthly at 11 AM and the roster mirrors the Greenville Journal ads (3 Fridays before sale). Browser only.

sources.source_name: Greenville County Tax Collector - Tax Sale Procedures
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched (host returned 403 for the MIE page). Search snippet: 2026 delinquent accounts due by Oct 16, 2026, so the 2026 sale is around late Oct / Nov 2026 at the Convention Center. Unsold parcels go to the Forfeited Land Commission (greenvillecounty.org/Treasurer/pdf/FLCAuction.pdf).

sources.source_name: Spartanburg County Tax Collector Delinquent Tax Sale notice (Document Center)
sources.notes: spartanburgcounty.org 301-redirects to spartanburgcounty.gov, which returned HTTP 403 to a plain request. Stopped. Fields from the search snippet (item #, map number, owner, property address); year of this notice unknown. Older lists (2016, 2017, 2019) also sit in the Document Center. Browser only.

sources.source_name: The Spartan Weekly legal notices - Master In Equity
sources.notes: Listing page fetched (no login, no captcha seen). Paged with /legal-notices/?page=N; each notice has its own page whose slug is the property address. Search snippets show address, case number and sale date (e.g. Sept 8, 2026 sales, 11 AM at the courthouse). No tax sale category. Terms not checked (/privacy page exists). Private newspaper, the county's legal organ for MIE ads. Best Spartanburg source found.

sources.source_name: The Spartan Weekly legal notices - Probate Court (Notice to Creditors of Estates)
sources.notes: Listing page showed 10 estate notices dated Nov 5, 2026, case numbers like 2026ES..., sequential numeric IDs in the URL. Notices name the decedent and personal representative (names not copied). Property address usually not given; needs parcel matching. Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: Alabama Dept. of Revenue state-held tax delinquent property transcript - Jefferson (Birmingham division)
sources.notes: Parcels that went unsold at the county tax sale and were bid in by the State. Headers only (HEAD): 200, PDF, 1.30 MB, Last-Modified 2026-11-06. Fields from ADOR 'How to Read the Transcript' instructions: assessed name, county code, year sold, C/S number, class, city code, parcel ID, legal description, assessed value, amount bid at tax sale. NO street address (state says so). URL is case-sensitive (.PDF; lowercase .pdf gives 404). Strong distress signal (3+ years delinquent possible).

sources.source_name: Alabama Dept. of Revenue state-held tax delinquent property transcript - Jefferson-Bessemer division
sources.notes: Same layout as WWW_TRANS_01. HEAD: 200, PDF, 376 KB, Last-Modified 2026-11-06. No street address; join to the county parcel layer by parcel ID. Index page: https://revenue.alabama.gov/property-tax/tax-delinquent-property/

sources.source_name: Jefferson County Tax Collector - 2025 Tax Delinquent Parcels, Birmingham Division
sources.notes: HTTP 403 Forbidden. Stopped using the host. Per search: lien auction for tax year 2025 ran online from May 5, 2026 (pay deadline May 4); prior years at /644, /647, /650. Bessemer division runs separately (205-481-4131). Lists likely posted ~March-April each year.

sources.source_name: Jefferson County tax lien investor portal (E-Ring)
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. Online lien auction platform; investor login required. Not usable by a server.

sources.source_name: Jefferson County Probate Court Landmark Web (land records and probate filings)
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. County says land records and probate filings are for subscribers; a third-party directory claims free registration. Either way an account is needed. Covers lis pendens, foreclosure deeds and probate estate filings.

sources.source_name: City of Birmingham GIS server (Code Enforcement Geocortex site, demolition layers)
sources.notes: Connection reset (ECONNRESET) on both the ArcGIS services directory and the Geocortex CodeEnforcement site; not retried further. Search shows a 'Demolition Quadrants' layer and a PEP map service exist. Unverified whether condemnation cases are exposed.

sources.source_name: Birmingham City Council agendas (weed abatement assessments, condemnation / demolition resolutions)
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. Weekly council agendas list properties for weed-abatement special assessments and unsafe-structure demolition. Long mixed-content PDFs; would need a parser. Example URL shown; new agendas follow the same /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/ pattern.

sources.source_name: Birmingham Land Bank Authority (City real estate / Transforming Birmingham)
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. Inquiry form plus RFP list; no public inventory list found. BLBA acquires parcels 5+ years tax delinquent.

sources.source_name: Shelby County Trustee tax sale property extract (CSV)
sources.notes: Linked from the Trustee's Tax Sale Schedule page. Only the header row was read (byte-range request): ParcelID, Alt_Parcel, Street Number, Street Name, Tax Sale, Register GIS. No owner and no amount column. 148 KB, Last-Modified 2026-11-09 12:30 GMT (refreshed at least daily; parcels drop off as paid). Best Shelby source found.

sources.source_name: Shelby County Trustee Tax Sale Schedule
sources.notes: Sale 2301 on 10/27/2026 (published 08/26/2026, Daily News); sale 2302 on 04/13/2027 (publication 02/16/2027). Bidding via zeusauction.com. The published notice includes parcel, owners, amount due, description. Also /161/Properties-Available-for-Sale (info page). No automation terms seen.

sources.source_name: Shelby County Land Bank properties for sale
sources.notes: HTTP 403 Forbidden. Stopped. Per search: parcels arrive after each Trustee tax sale (2-4 per year); browsing the property list requires creating an account on the portal.

sources.source_name: The Daily News (Memphis) public notices by date (substitute trustee sales, tax sale notices)
sources.notes: Connection refused (ECONNREFUSED) on the one fetch; not retried. Search results show one page per publication day (/notices/YYYY/Mon/D/) listing foreclosure notices with property address and publication dates. TN foreclosure is non-judicial, so this newspaper is the main pre-sale signal for Shelby. Terms not checked; paywall status unknown.

sources.source_name: Shelby County Register of Deeds search
sources.notes: Search app is JavaScript-rendered; plain fetch showed only a loading shell, so search by instrument type (lis pendens, substitute trustee deed) is unconfirmed. Home page warns name searches are returning incomplete results. Third-party directories call it free. Browser check needed.

sources.source_name: City of Memphis ArcGIS code enforcement services
sources.notes: ComEnh_CodeEnf_Service and PublicWorks/Code_EnvEnf_Services_Prod returned 'service not started' (HTTP 500 body); Tolemi/Tolemi_Feed (blight platform) returned 'Token Required' (499). Memphis Open Data Hub (data.memphistn.gov, ArcGIS Hub) has no code enforcement or 311 dataset in its search API.

sources.source_name: Metro Nashville Property Standards Violations (Codes) - open data
sources.notes: Listed on data.nashville.gov (Hub item 038de0cf3d35435c8c563b731265c036, titled 'Property Standards Requests', modified 2026-11-09). Fields: Request_Nbr, Date_Received, Property_APN (stored as float - keep as string/pad), Property_Address, City, ZIP, Property_Owner, Complaint_Source, Reported_Problem, Status, Last_Activity_Date, Last_Activity, Last_Act__Result, Violations_Noted, Subtype_Description, Lat/Lon. maxRecordCount 1000, Query enabled. Best Davidson source found.

sources.source_name: Davidson County Clerk & Master delinquent tax sale schedule and lists
sources.notes: No property list posted right now. Sales Sep-Dec 2026 were CANCELLED (Trustee software change); next sale January 20, 2027, ad roughly 4 weeks before. Past lists were PDFs in /wp-content/uploads/ (e.g. January16th_Tax-Sale2023_3.pdf: parcel/property list with amounts, per search). Also posts an Excess Proceeds PDF (Excess-Proceeds-11-2-2026.pdf) - after-sale surplus, not opened. Info page: /fees/delinquent-tax-sales/. No automation terms seen.

sources.source_name: Davidson County Register of Deeds online records (subscription)
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. Online index is paid ($50/month single user) via davidsonportal.com per the Register's public records policy. Not usable without Gabriel enabling a paid service. Free ownership check: Metro Planning parcel maps.

sources.source_name: Davidson County Circuit Court Clerk - Probate Estate Lookup
sources.notes: Page fetched: public lookup 'for informational purposes only', terms cover accuracy only (no automation ban stated). Search mechanics not visible in plain fetch (likely an embedded app). Full case access is CaseLink at $25/month (paid). No new-filings list found.

sources.source_name: City of St. Petersburg active codes cases (ArcGIS layer 'Codes Cases')
sources.notes: Service description: active codes cases imported to GIS nightly. Fields are CASEYEAR, CASENUM, CASETYPE, CASEDATE, PIN (parcel) plus point geometry. No street address field (join PIN to parcels) and no owner field. Query supported, maxRecordCount 1000 (page through). City of St. Petersburg only, not all of Pinellas. Copyright line 'City of St. Petersburg'; no separate terms page seen.

sources.source_name: City of St. Petersburg 'Vacant' and 'City Owned' parcel layers (Codes map service)
sources.notes: Layer 2 'Vacant' has PARCELID, SITEADDRESS, PRPRTYDSCRP, CATEGORY, STRAP. No description, so it is probably vacant LAND by use code, not a vacant-building registry. Layer 3 'City Owned' is in the same service (fields not checked). Use as a supporting signal only. The city also keeps a 'Vacant and Boarded' list, but no dataset was found for it.

sources.source_name: Pinellas Clerk tax deed sales, lands available and foreclosure sales (mypinellasclerk.gov)

sources.source_name: Pinellas Clerk online foreclosure auction (RealForeclose)

sources.source_name: Polk Tax Collector delinquency and tax certificate sale information
sources.notes: No downloadable delinquent list. The delinquent roll is advertised in a newspaper for 3 weeks before the certificate sale (on or before June 1), which runs at polkfl.realtaxlien.com (registered bidders only). Tax deed applications: realtda.com (vendor, not fetched). Newspaper ads reach floridapublicnotices.com.

sources.source_name: City of Lakeland Code Enforcement Board agendas (PDF)
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. Search snippets say each monthly agenda lists cases (LCE case number, property address, owner, cited ordinance, order status). The URL changes every month (media id), so a scraper would need the index page (not found). Needs a parser. City of Lakeland only. No Polk County code-case layer was found. Lakeland GIS has a 'Lakeland10_CD_Data' service tagged Code Enforcement (layers not checked).

sources.source_name: Duval Clerk tax deed files and Lands Available
sources.notes: Fetch failed with connection refused (ECONNREFUSED), so this needs a retry from a normal network. Search shows the page links tax deed files from after May 2021 (new system) and older ones. Lands Available buyers request a statement, first come, first served. Auctions are at duval.realtaxdeed.com (vendor, do not fetch). Format and fields not confirmed.

sources.source_name: Duval Clerk CORE court records portal (foreclosure and probate cases)
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. The public basic level can view foreclosure cases, but probate records need a registered account (signed registration agreement). Searches need a case number or party name, so there is no 'new filings' list. Captcha not confirmed. Foreclosure auctions: duval.realforeclose.com (vendor, do not fetch). Browser-only.

sources.source_name: Jacksonville Municipal Code Compliance Division (cases, fines, liens by public records request)
sources.notes: No downloadable case list on the page. Case details, case status and nuisance liens need a public records request (records.coj.net). An unofficial guide mentions 'Case Search.xlsx' (active cases) and 'Administrative Fines.xlsx' files, but no official link was found. maps.coj.net (city ArcGIS) refused the connection (ECONNREFUSED). Not retried.

sources.source_name: City of Orlando Code Enforcement Cases (Socrata, rolling 5 years)
sources.notes: Best automatable code source in this group. Updated 2026-11-08. It has 31 columns, including Case Address, Parcel ID, Case Number, Case Type, Case Status, Case Milestone, Case Open Date, Resolution Date, Case Comments, Location Notes, and GPS X and Y. 'Case Name' may hold an owner or business name (not inspected), so treat it as a possible owner field and keep it out of logs. Filter by open status and recent open date. City of Orlando only. Related views: cjrh-emwu (last 3 months), u9mk-bwhq (last 12 months). Terms not checked.

sources.source_name: Orange County (unincorporated) Code Enforcement 'Active Violations' layer
sources.notes: Fields: INCI_ID, INCI_TYP, INCI_DESC, INCI_ST_CD, INSP_RES_DT, INSP_RESULTS, CE_OFFICIAL_PARCEL_ID, CE_COMPLETE_ADDRESS, CE_LINK. NAME_NAME, NAME_ST_ADDR_1 and NAME_ST_ADDR_2 look like a name and mailing address (treat as owner fields, do not log). Query, JSON/GeoJSON, pagination supported. maxRecordCount 2000. Layers 4 and 5 (EPD violations) are environmental. Cadence not stated. Per-property lookup also at netapps.ocfl.net/CETitleViolationSearch.

sources.source_name: Orange County 'Foreclosures' layer (historical only, ends 2013)
sources.notes: Stale, do not use for leads. A stats query shows max YEAR 2013 and max RECORDING_DATE 2013-02-15. Looks like an old vendor feed (borrower, lender, trustee, default amount, opening bid, auction date). Listed only so nobody mistakes it for a live source.

sources.source_name: Orange County Comptroller official records search
sources.notes: Found via search (help page at /recorder/web/help.jsp), not fetched. Supports name searches. A lis pendens document-type filter, captcha and disclaimer were not confirmed. Court cases: myeclerk.myorangeclerk.com (free public search, account registration exists; captcha not confirmed). Tax deed auctions: orange.realtaxdeed.com (vendor). Comptroller tax deed notices appear in Business Observer legal notices. Browser-only until checked.

sources.source_name: Florida Press Association statewide public notice site
sources.notes: Required by law (s. 50.0211) to carry every newspaper legal notice: foreclosure sales, tax deed applications, delinquent tax ads, and probate notices to creditors for all FL counties. Free search. The current database covers 4 weeks, with a 3-year archive. Saved searches can email daily results. One notice page returned HTTP 500 (server error, not a block) and was not retried. Terms page not found, and captcha not confirmed. Treat as browser or operator-assisted until the terms are read.

sources.source_name: City of Cleveland Current Condemnations (Building & Housing)
sources.notes: City of Cleveland open data (owner account opendataCLE). Layer fields checked via ?f=json; count via returnCountOnly. Last data edit 2026-11-08 (Sunday), consistent with the city's weekly Sunday refresh used on sibling layers. No owner field. maxRecordCount 1000, so page with resultOffset. Cleveland city only, not suburbs. Terms not checked beyond the ODbL license on the sibling item.

sources.source_name: City of Cleveland Issued Building Violations (Complaint Violation Notices)
sources.notes: ArcGIS item 3fbae9a4d11f4af0be19912109c0cbff, license ODbL, updated weekly on Sundays 7 AM ET per metadata. Field list and count from the hub dataset record; service URL from the item's sharing record. No owner field. Same org also publishes Violation_Status_History, Rental_Registrations and Demolition_Permits.

sources.source_name: City of Cleveland Land Bank lots
sources.notes: City-owned land bank lots (mostly vacant land, separate from the county land bank). Last edit epoch about 2026-11-08. Related services in the same org: Cleveland_Land_Bank_Available_Parcels_2024, Cleveland_Land_Bank_Possible_Large_Lot (fields not checked). No owner field.

sources.source_name: City of Cleveland Demolition Permits
sources.notes: Seen in the org's service directory only; layer fields not checked. Check ?f=json on layer 0 before use.

sources.source_name: Cuyahoga Land Bank homes for sale
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. County land bank (non-profit county land reutilization corporation). Search snippets mention about 60 homes for sale, mostly deed-in-escrow renovation properties, plus a vacant-lot list for side yards. Small, slow-changing inventory; browser check is enough.

sources.source_name: Cuyahoga County Fiscal Officer delinquent tax list publication
sources.notes: Found via search; fetch failed with DNS error (ENOTFOUND) for both cuyahogacounty.gov and www.cuyahogacounty.gov on 2026-11-09, so format and fields are unknown. Annual list required by Ohio Rev. Code 5721.03, published in a newspaper. Retry later from the server's network.

sources.source_name: Cuyahoga County Sheriff sale auction (RealAuction)
sources.notes: HTTP 403 on first and only fetch. RealAuction-run Ohio state sheriff sale site (foreclosure and tax foreclosure sheriff sales). Operator browser only.

sources.source_name: City of Columbus Code Enforcement Cases (Building & Zoning Services)
sources.notes: ArcGIS item 1d61669223fa42ba87a4d73a46e5361a, public domain (CC0). Includes closed history; filter on status and file date. maxRecordCount 2000. No owner field. Columbus city only. Layer 24 in the same service is 'Building Compliance Cases' (fields not checked).

sources.source_name: City of Columbus Building Compliance Cases
sources.notes: Seen in the service layer list only; fields not checked.

sources.source_name: Columbus Land Redevelopment Properties (city and county land bank)
sources.notes: ArcGIS item c4eb7ff33e1d435db0b705ce297b6231, CC0. Item metadata last modified 2021-10-18, but the layer has its own LAST_EDIT_DATE per row, so check freshness with a max() query before relying on it. Covers Columbus and Franklin County land bank holdings per catalog description. No owner field.

sources.source_name: Central Ohio Community Improvement Corp (Franklin County land bank) listings
sources.notes: Found via search (City of Columbus page says county land bank listings are on COCIC.org), not fetched. Exact listing page URL not confirmed.

sources.source_name: Franklin County Auditor delinquent tax list / search
sources.notes: HTTP 403 on first and only fetch; stopped. Search snippet (staging site) said results were current to 2025-07-16 due to maintenance. Annual newspaper publication required by Ohio law.

sources.source_name: Franklin County Treasurer tax lien certificate sale / tax foreclosure pages
sources.notes: Fetched the sibling Foreclosure page: no downloadable lists are published. Per search snippet, the tax lien sale list is sent by email on request. Tax foreclosures and expedited land bank foreclosures then go to sheriff sale. Not automatable as-is.

sources.source_name: Franklin County Sheriff sale auction (RealAuction)
sources.notes: HTTP 403 on first and only fetch. Operator browser only.

sources.source_name: Indianapolis Code Enforcement Violations and Investigations (DBNS)
sources.notes: Non-spatial table (no geometry) on the city's open-data server; very large history, so filter by open_date and case_status. Has an owner field (do not log values). maxRecordCount 1000. Unsafe-building cases appear as a case type here as far as known; no separate unsafe-building or vacant layer found. The xmaps.indy.gov OpenData folder requires a token (HTTP 499); use gis.indy.gov.

sources.source_name: Marion County Treasurer/Auditor tax sale reports (advertising, status, sold, county lien lists)
sources.notes: Fetched but the page is rendered by JavaScript; plain fetch returned no links. Search snippets say it posts yearly Sold, County Lien, Status and Combination lists (latest set seen: 2025) and that the 2026 sale ran Oct 13-16. Older years are on data.indy.gov as 'Tax Sale Reports <year>' items. Operator browser or a JS-capable fetch needed; file format not confirmed.

sources.source_name: Indianapolis Tax Sale Viewer map services
sources.notes: Folder returns ArcGIS error 499 'Token Required'. Public viewer is maps.indy.gov/TaxSaleViewer/. Not usable without a token; do not try to obtain one.

sources.source_name: Renew Indianapolis property inventory
sources.notes: Fetch failed: TLS certificate expired (both www and bare host). Inventory page and fields not confirmed. Recheck later; do not ignore certificate errors on a server.

sources.source_name: Indiana MyCase statewide court case search (mortgage foreclosure and estate cases)
sources.notes: Not fetched (known statewide portal; verify). Covers Marion Superior Court foreclosure (MF) and estate/probate (ES/EU) case types. Terms not checked; treat as operator-browser search until terms are reviewed. Probate source for Marion as well.

sources.source_name: Kansas City property violations from EnerGov (EG NPD Violations)
sources.notes: Kansas City (Neighborhood Preservation) violations. Catalog says data last updated 2026-04-30, so it may have stopped refreshing; check before relying on it. max(date_found) returned a 2029 value, so date fields contain typos; validate. Filtered view 'Open violations - exterior building issues' is w5nm-8qv8. Older archived set nhtf-e75a stopped 2022-09. No owner field. KC city only (Jackson County also includes Independence and other cities). Check freshness before building: last refresh seen 2026-04 (violations) / 2025-07 (land bank).

sources.source_name: Kansas City Dangerous Buildings List
sources.notes: Neighborhoods and Housing Services; public domain per search snippet. Metadata rowsUpdatedAt about 2026-08-19. No owner field. Strong distress signal (dangerous / demolition-track buildings).

sources.source_name: Kansas City Land Bank and Homesteading Authority data
sources.notes: Field list from the Socrata catalog API (api.us.socrata.com); data_updated_at 2025-07-29, so possibly stale; related map/chart views updated 2026-09-21. No owner field (it is all city land bank). Market value is assessor value, never a comp. Check freshness before building: last refresh seen 2026-04 (violations) / 2025-07 (land bank).

sources.source_name: Jackson County Delinquent Land Tax Sale (Collection Dept. / 16th Circuit Court Civil Process)
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. County page: https://www.jacksongov.org/Government/Departments/Collection/Delinquent-Land-Tax-Sale. News reports say the 2026 sale (set for August) was cancelled by executive order, so no current list. Properties with 3 years unpaid taxes. Recheck in 2027.

sources.source_name: Missouri Case.net statewide court case search (probate and civil)
sources.notes: Not fetched (known statewide portal; verify). Covers Jackson County (16th Circuit) and St. Louis City (22nd Circuit) probate estates and civil cases, including tax foreclosure suits. Missouri mortgage foreclosures are mostly non-judicial (trustee sales), so they appear as newspaper notices, not court cases. Terms not checked; operator browser.

sources.source_name: St. Louis Land Reutilization Authority (LRA) inventory CSV
sources.notes: Connection refused (ECONNREFUSED) on 3 fetches across the stlouis-mo.gov host on 2026-11-09; stopped. Search snippet: nightly CSV of all LRA inventory except sold/retired, with acquisition date, parcel, property source, status and usage; a separate 'For Sale' CSV exists (dataset page id=30). Likely automatable once the host is reachable.

Per search snippet: list of all vacant buildings maintained by Building Division inspectors, including violations and invoices, coverage 2017 to present (dataset page id=108). Bulk downloads page https://dynamic.stlouis-mo.gov/opendata/downloads.cfm reportedly has an Inspections Access database (incl. condemnations, updated 2026-08-16) and an old 2021 condemnations file. Recheck.

sources.source_name: St. Louis City Sheriff current land tax sale properties
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched (host refusing connections). List posted two weeks before each sale; snippets say 2026 land tax sales have concluded (sale 240 on Oct 6, 2026). Collector's suit and sale schedule: https://www.stlouis-mo.gov/government/departments/collector/real-estate-tax/property-sales.cfm (tax_delinquent signal: properties in delinquent land tax suit).

sources.source_name: Detroit Land Bank Authority properties for sale (City of Detroit open data)
sources.notes: Last data edit 2026-11-08; cadence inferred as daily from edit times, not documented. Same org also has DLBA_Owned_Properties, dlba_auction_sales, dlba_own_it_now_sales (fields not checked). Machine-readable alternative to buildingdetroit.org. No owner field.

sources.source_name: Detroit Land Bank Authority property listings (buildingdetroit.org)
sources.notes: Already in our repo. Light check: page loads as a JavaScript shell; listings come from a client-side JSON call not visible in a static fetch. Listing types: Auction, Own It Now, Rehabbed & Ready, Side Lot. Has an optional sign-in for bidding; listings themselves are public.

sources.source_name: Detroit blight tickets (Department of Administrative Hearings)
sources.notes: Updated once daily per catalog. Contains owner name and owner mailing-address fields (do not log or report values). Unpaid judgments and balances are a useful distress signal. Tickets can later be voided. maxRecordCount 1000.

sources.source_name: Detroit demolition pipeline
sources.notes: Buildings slated for city demolition; last edit 2026-11-08. Same org also has bseed_vacant_property_registrations, bseed_demolition_permits, Completed_Residential_Demolitions (fields not checked). No owner field.

sources.source_name: Detroit BSEED vacant property registrations
sources.notes: Seen in the service directory only; fields not checked.

sources.notes: Index page fetched: https://www.waynecountymi.gov/Government/Elected-Officials/Treasurer/Property-Tax-Information/Forfeited-Property-List-with-Interested-Parties lists yearly PDFs 2011-2026. The 2026 PDF is 12 MB and was not downloaded (light sampling), so fields are not confirmed; title implies it lists interested parties (names). Parsing a 12 MB PDF is feasible but heavy. Terms not stated on page. Also: Detroit Legal News tax lien search https://legalnews.com/Home/Tax_Liens (not fetched).

sources.source_name: Wayne County Treasurer tax foreclosure auctions and claims
sources.notes: Found via search, not fetched. Auctions sold as-is with quit claim deed; 2026 auctions reportedly ran in August. Bidding happens on a vendor auction site (not checked). A prior-year PDF 'list of properties foreclosed in 2025' exists on the same host. Post-foreclosure surplus-claim lists are also posted here.

sources.source_name: Detroit Legal News public notices (mortgage foreclosure by advertisement)
sources.notes: URL is one example notice (per-notice pages by numeric id); the notice index/search page was not located. One notice page fetched; publicly viewable, no captcha seen; a Login link exists. Michigan mortgage foreclosures are non-judicial (sale by advertisement, sheriff sale at the Wayne County Circuit Court building), with notices running about 4 weeks before sale and a 6-month redemption (30 days if abandoned). Parcel number often missing. Private legal newspaper, not a government host; Terms of Use page (/Home/TermsOfUse) not read, so marked not automatable until terms are reviewed. Contains borrower names in notice text (do not store).
